title: nyblnet/bento
claim: nyblnet/bento — Bento, the office suite that fits in a file
why_good: Bento's lightweight approach to office productivity tools could appeal to remote and hybrid teams seeking efficiency without the bloat of traditional suites.
value: Businesses could pay for premium features or integrations, creating a subscription model for teams that want enhanced collaboration tools.
risk: The project may struggle against established players like Microsoft and Google, who could easily replicate its features and leverage their existing user bases.
